Civil & Architectural Engineering
Message from CAE
Welcome to the Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering (CAE) at Tennessee State University.The Department has a long tradition dating back to 1954, and is widely acknowledged as the premier Civil and Architectural Engineering program in the South East. Our programs have very strong links to the architecture, engineering and construction (AEC) industry. We have a reputation as a friendly, open academic environment where students and faculty can pursue their interests.
The CAE Department is committed to quality teaching, research and service. The department takes great pride in preparation of students to excel in their professional careers. Our graduates apply scientific and engineering principles to the plan, design, construction and maintenance of buildings and infrastructure systems, and are equipped to work in a variety of roles in design, construction, government, education and other industry sectors. They are very highly sought after and most of our alumni are active in the planning, design and construction of high profile building and infrastructure projects both in the US and around the world.
The department encompasses two ABET-accredited B.S. degrees:
Civil Engineering
Architectural Engineering.
The undergraduate degrees in Civil and Architectural Engineering have a common interest in structures and construction engineering. With Architectural Engineering Program-we have three specializations-structures, mechanical/electrical/lighting, and construction management. Dual degrees are possible in Architectural and Civil Engineering. Undergraduate Civil Engineering Program and Undergraduate Architectural Engineering Programs accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, https://www.abet.org. The department also administers a combined graduate program that awards a Master Degree in Engineering and PhD Degree. The Master Degree focuses on three major areas of the department: Civil Infrastructures, Transportation and Environmental / Water Resources. The PhD Degree focuses on Ph.D. in Engineering and Computational Sciences (ENCS) with two concentration areas: (1) Engineering Systems and (2) Computational Sciences.
This Web site contains much useful information for students (current and prospective), industry partners, faculty and staff, alumni and friends. Thank for your interest in the Department and feel free to contact us. Welcome to visit the beautiful campus at Nashville.

Giving it CAE Department
Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering at Tennessee State University sincerely thank our alumni, friends, and supporters for giving to the “Civil Engineering Program” and “Architectural Engineering Program” at TSU. Our program continues to grow. Your contributions truly make a difference.
Instructions:
Checks should be made payable to Tennessee State University Foundation
(with the memo to “Civil Engineering Program” or “Architectural Engineering Program”)
Please indicate your gift designation in the memo section of your check.
Mail gift to:
TSU Foundation
3500 John A. Merritt Blvd.
Campus Box 9542
Nashville, TN 37209
For pledges and credit card payment, please include the Contribution Commitment Form.
